query: How long does it take to process applications relating to the Self-Employed Scheme?
reference_answer: The applications relating to the Self-Employed Scheme will generally be processed within the service standards as stated in the table below. Generally, Singapore PR applications take about six months to process, provided all the required documents are submitted. Depending on the complexity of the case, some applications may take more than six months to process.The main applicant/sponsor will be informed of the outcome via email/post. Meanwhile, your sponsor may check the status of your PR application online through ICA e-Service. New or repeated applications, for the same person(s), will not be accepted while the current application is still in process.

The processing time of a visa application is within three working days (excluding the day of submission). However, some applications may take a longer time to process. You may use the ICA e-Service to enquire application status. Do note that you will require the visa reference number and applicant's travel document number.
answer: According to [Document 1], applications for the Self-Employed Scheme are processed within the service standards, which include 12 to 15 working days for refunds and payments. [Document 3] specifies 12 to 15 working days for online and manual transactions respectively. [Document 4] notes visa applications can take up to 6 months but some may take longer.
